latest_release.name: v1.0.238
latest_release.body:
# Features

* feat(settings): label a plugin's vault secret by its key's description by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11765

# Fixes

* fix(terminal): unbounded O(n²) output buffer for tabs that were never focused by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11722
* fix(terminal): every closed tab leaks its terminal (WebGL cursor blink timer never disposed) by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11720
* fix(terminal): closed sessions leak via PTY IPC listeners (destroy() re-entrancy) by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11719
* fix(terminal): send current terminal size in the deferred initial resize by @anseltaft in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11760
* fix(terminal): don't steal focus from modal dialog inputs by @siparker in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11745
* fix(core): don't fire a hotkey twice for one keystroke by @bptrsn in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11769
* fix(app): keep the window draggable by its tab bar while a dialog is open by @meanaverage in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11766
* fix(ssh): pass PuTTY (.ppk) private keys to WinSCP without converting them by @manjotsc in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11767

## New Contributors
* @meanaverage made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11719
* @siparker made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11745
* @manjotsc made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11767
* @bptrsn made their first contribution in https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/pull/11769

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/compare/v1.0.237...v1.0.238

--- > 👋 Managing remote environments? Check out [Warpgate, my smart SSH/HTTP/MySQL bastion server](https://github.com/warp-tech/warpgate), it works great with Tabby, you'll love it. ---- ### Downloads: * [Latest release](https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby/releases/latest) * [Repositories](https://packagecloud.io/eugeny/tabby): [Debian/Ubuntu-based](https://packagecloud.io/eugeny/tabby/install#bash-deb), [RPM-based](https://packagecloud.io/eugeny/tabby/install#bash-rpm) * [Latest nightly build](https://nightly.link/Eugeny/tabby/workflows/build/master)

This README is also available in: :es: Spanish · :ru: Русский · :kr: 한국어 · :cn: 简体中文 · :it: Italiano · :de: Deutsch · :jp: 日本語 · :id: Bahasa Indonesia · :brazil: Português · :poland: Polski

---- [**Tabby**](https://tabby.sh) (formerly **Terminus**) is a highly configurable terminal emulator, SSH and serial client for Windows, macOS and Linux * Integrated SSH and Telnet client and connection manager * Integrated serial terminal * Theming and color schemes * Fully configurable shortcuts and multi-chord shortcuts * Split panes * Remembers your tabs * PowerShell (and PS Core), WSL, Git-Bash, Cygwin, MSYS2, Cmder and CMD support * Direct file transfer from/to SSH sessions via Zmodem * Full Unicode support including double-width characters * Doesn't choke on fast-flowing outputs * Proper shell experience on Windows including tab completion (via Clink) * Integrated encrypted container for SSH secrets and configuration * SSH, SFTP and Telnet client available as a [web app](https://tabby.sh/app) (also [self-hosted](https://github.com/Eugeny/tabby-web)). # Contents
